summary: Frontend-only validation of the 4 mobile fixes on preview (Galaxy S10 / 360x760). All 9 requested checks PASS: (1) core-js/regenerator polyfills present — Object.hasOwn, Array.prototype.at, String.prototype.at all functions. (2) mobile-menu-open hamburger visible at 360px and hidden at 1440px. (3) Drawer opens (panel visible), body scroll lock engaged (document.body.style.overflow === 'hidden'); close button restores scroll (overflow becomes ''). (4) Unauth drawer shows mobile-nav-daily/login/register + Pourquoi + EHPAD links; clicking mobile-nav-daily navigates to /quiz-du-jour and closes drawer. (5) Auth admin drawer shows all 8 expected testids (dashboard, atelier, leagues, progression, challenges, earn-credits, account, admin-analytics) + logout; logout button navigates away and closes drawer. (6) Desktop nav intact at 1440x900: nav-dashboard, nav-atelier, nav-admin-analytics visible, hamburger hidden. (7) No horizontal overflow on any tested route at 360px: scrollWidth === innerWidth (360) on /, /pourquoi, /ehpad, /app/dashboard. (8) SeniorModeToggle rendered in drawer footer. (9) No JS runtime errors; 401 console logs are expected auth pre-checks pre-login.

issues: Nav is very cramped — labels 'Quiz du Jour', 'Mes quiz', 'Défi famille', 'Mon compte' wrap to 2-3 lines and 'Signalements' clips off the right edge. Not in scope of the mobile fix but worth trimming labels or increasing md-breakpoint threshold to lg for full nav.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileMenu.jsx: body-scroll cleanup relies on effect cleanup; if a component unmounts while drawer is open (e.g. logout redirect), the previous overflow value is restored correctly — verified working (overflow returned to '').
index.js: core-js/stable + regenerator-runtime imported first — correct. Note this increases initial bundle size ~30KB gz; acceptable trade-off for Samsung Galaxy S10 compatibility.
Navbar hidden at md breakpoint (768px). Given how packed the desktop nav is at 1440 (labels wrapping), consider bumping to lg (1024px) for the split or trimming labels.
MobileMenu Pourquoi/EHPAD links do not have data-testid attributes (only asserted by text). Consider adding mobile-nav-pourquoi / mobile-nav-ehpad for future testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile fixes iteration 30 fully validated on preview at 360x760 and 1440x900. Polyfills, hamburger, drawer open/close, body-scroll lock, unauth+admin drawer link sets, no horizontal overflow on Landing/Pourquoi/EHPAD/Dashboard, and desktop no-regression all confirmed. Safe for user to redeploy to production (generaquiz.fr).
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a fix-validation iteration, not a bug hunt. All 4 preview fixes (core-js polyfills, MobileMenu drawer, index.css overflow-x guard, Navbar integration) verified functional.
